import re, math, json

# 1) Re-fetch cart to ensure we have current totals and promo info
cart_before = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=amazon_token)
print('cart_before keys', sorted(cart_before.keys()))
print('cart_before', cart_before)

# 2) Extract promo code from the Amazon Promotions email thread found earlier
thread_id = 47823
thread = apis.gmail.show_thread(email_thread_id=thread_id, access_token=gmail_token)
print('thread_id', thread_id, 'emails', len(thread.get('emails',[])), 'read', thread.get('read'))

# Combine all email bodies in thread
bodies = []
for e in thread.get('emails',[]):
    bodies.append(e.get('body',''))
body_all = '\n'.join(bodies)
# regex patterns for promo codes
codes = set(re.findall(r'Promo Code\s*=>\s*([A-Za-z0-9]+)', body_all))
codes |= set(re.findall(r'Promo code\s*=>\s*([A-Za-z0-9]+)', body_all))
codes |= set(re.findall(r'promo code\s*=>\s*([A-Za-z0-9]+)', body_all))
print('promo codes extracted', sorted(codes))

# Choose likely best candidate: longest alphanumeric code
promo_codes_sorted = sorted(codes, key=lambda x: (-len(x), x))
new_promo_code = promo_codes_sorted[0] if promo_codes_sorted else None
print('new_promo_code', new_promo_code)

old_promo_code = cart_before.get('promo_code')
print('old_promo_code', old_promo_code)

# Step: fetch addresses and payment cards once, then compare promo codes by applying the new promo and checking totals

addresses = apis.amazon.show_addresses(access_token=amazon_token)
payment_cards = apis.amazon.show_payment_cards(access_token=amazon_token)

print('addresses_count', len(addresses))
print('addresses', addresses)
print('payment_cards_count', len(payment_cards))
print('payment_cards', payment_cards)

old_cart = cart_before  # from previous code block
old_total = old_cart['total_cost']
old_discount = old_cart['discount']
old_promo = old_cart['promo_code']
print('old_promo', old_promo, 'old_total', old_total, 'old_discount', old_discount, 'promo_valid', old_cart['promo_valid'])

# Apply new promo code from email
new_promo = new_promo_code
print('applying_new_promo', new_promo)
applied_new = apis.amazon.apply_promo_code_to_cart(promo_code=new_promo, access_token=amazon_token)
print('apply_new_response', applied_new)

cart_new = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=amazon_token)
print('cart_new', cart_new)
new_total = cart_new['total_cost']
new_discount = cart_new['discount']
print('new_promo_used', cart_new.get('promo_code'), 'new_total', new_total, 'new_discount', new_discount, 'promo_valid', cart_new['promo_valid'])

# Decide cheaper
cheaper = 'new' if new_total < old_total else 'old'
print('cheaper_choice', cheaper)

if cheaper == 'old':
    # Restore old promo
    print('restoring_old_promo', old_promo)
    restored = apis.amazon.apply_promo_code_to_cart(promo_code=old_promo, access_token=amazon_token)
    print('restore_response', restored)
    cart_restored = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=amazon_token)
    print('cart_restored', cart_restored)
    print('restored_total', cart_restored['total_cost'], 'restored_promo', cart_restored['promo_code'])
else:
    cart_to_order = cart_new
    print('keeping_new_promo_for_order')
    cart_restored = None

cart_to_order = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=amazon_token)
print('cart_to_order_final', cart_to_order)

now = datetime.now()
cur_year = now.year
cur_month = now.month

print('addresses_now', addresses_now)
print('payment_cards_now', payment_cards_now)

# Determine non-expired payment cards (expiry_year-month)
valid_cards = []
for c in payment_cards_now:
    exp_y = int(c.get('expiry_year'))
    exp_m = int(c.get('expiry_month'))
    # assume card valid through end of expiry month
    if (exp_y > cur_year) or (exp_y == cur_year and exp_m >= cur_month):
        valid_cards.append(c)
